compaction.instructions: Summarize the older conversation for continued work. Preserve goals, decisions, useful file paths, verified results, failures, unresolved questions, and a concrete next action. Distinguish observations from assumptions. Incorporate still-relevant facts from the previous summary. Return only the summary, without tools.

self_assessment.error: Uses a verdicts object instead of the required requirements array.
self_assessment.interpretation: All five claims agree with independent checks, but the original report is retained as a schema failure. No automatic normalization or replacement.

compaction_failure.interpretation: The model spent the summary output budget on reasoning. Existing controller policy requires explicit normal completion and stopped without applying an incomplete summary.

model_findings.evidence: Wrote an 8686-byte test file, then supplied a 411-byte replacement. Both write_file results confirmed those lengths. A subsequent Python invocation exited zero without executing a test runner.
Summary said the earlier test file got truncated and called it a harness/writing artifact. Archived requests instead show the model supplied the replacement.
Four nonzero test commands were visible. Model reconstructed its file and fixed faulty tests; final full model-authored run reported 19 passed, 0 failed.
Produced valid JSON and checked its own verdicts object, but did not follow the requested requirements-array schema.
Printed failures for behavior explicitly outside the task domain. Its advance(0) independence check compared a whole state list to scalar 1.0, producing a false failure. Command exited zero.

system_findings: Tool replacement and nonzero results were correctly recorded; no evidence that the bridge truncated the test file.
Summary budgeting with thinking enabled can exhaust all 4096 output tokens before visible summary text, ending a run early.
The controller reported compaction_failed, preserved known token usage, captured final files, and completed cleanup. Independent task correctness must remain separate from terminal outcome.
limitations: Single trial; no comparative model ranking
Finite behavioral cases do not prove universal correctness
Task may be too easy to expose mistaken self-assessment
Compaction is observed if it occurs, not guaranteed
Checker is not a security boundary against adversarial grading evasion
Trial ended after approximately 157 seconds; this is not a completed ten-minute run.
GPU time series started after the early stop; a separate during-run observation showed 23015 MiB and 94% utilization.
next_question: Review purpose-specific summary reasoning settings/budgets before another ten-minute run; do not change acceptance checks after seeing the candidate.
